message.content:
features
	CFDP_Library
		or
			send
				optional
					Send_Acknowledged_Mode
				optional
					send_fs_operations
				optional
					send_encryption
				optional
					send_compression
			receive
				optional
					Receive_Acknowledged_Mode
				optional
					receive_fs_operations
				optional
					receive_encryption
				optional
					receive_compression
			pus
				optional
					pus_rename
				optional
					pus_copy
				optional
					pus_logging
			Reboot
				optional
					Reboot_Entity
				optional
					reboot_pus
				optional
					reboot_delay
constraints
	pus_copy requires send
	pus_copy requires receive
	pus_rename requires send_fs_operations
	pus_rename requires receive_fs_operations
	reboot_pus requires pus
	send_encryption requires send
	receive_encryption requires receive
	send_compression requires send
	receive_compression requires receive
	pus_logging requires pus
